items.title: Gemini for Android rolls out a redesigned in-app camera
items.summary: 9to5Google 報道，Gemini Android 應用程式已在正式版（17.76 或更新）同測試版廣泛推出全新內嵌式相機介面，由畫面底部上拉拍攝，並可控制閃光燈同前後鏡頭。報道指呢個改版早前已在 iOS 版 Gemini 出現。

items.title: OpenAI's chief scientist proposes perplexity as a shared metric to pace AI progress
items.summary: OpenAI 首席科學家 Jakub Pachocki 發表文章，主張用困惑度（perplexity）作為比較各家模型進度、並建立共同安全標準的指標，同時公開公司內部預訓練困惑度變化。佢寫到而家模型損失已低於 0.8，並出現網絡安全同數學等能力；文章建議業界以呢個指標設定共同上限，直至監控能力達致指定里程碑。
items.note: Source page lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. TechCrunch covered the post at 1:14 p.m. PST on Nov 22 (5:14 a.m. HKT on Nov 23).
items.imageAlt: Social card for OpenAI's Perplexity and Intelligence essay

items.title: Hong Kong Development Bureau details AI flood monitoring and the Ping Che stormwater tank
items.summary: 發展局局長甯漢豪在11月22日網誌交代，渠務署10月底啟用容量2,000立方米的坪輋雨水蓄洪池，並建立四套智能系統，包括可提前一兩小時識別水浸風險的「淼立識」、在三個地點試行的「淼弈析」，以及與科大合作、分析逾300支警務處「銳眼」鏡頭的人工智能水浸監測系統。署方又指，人工智能泵組健康監測系統會持續收集振動數據，異常時即時提示人員。
items.note: The Development Bureau blog lists the date only; exact publish time is unknown, so publishedAt uses T00:00+08:00. RTHK reported the same blog at 12:50 HKT on Nov 22.
items.imageAlt: 渠務署工程師介紹防洪基建同人工智能應急系統

items.title: 2026 Hong Kong AI Science Week opens today with 22 public workshops
items.summary: 橙新聞報道，由紫荊文化集團主辦、中國基金報牽頭承辦的「2026香港AI科普周暨AI未來生活節」於11月23日啟動，將在校園同觀塘、沙田社區舉辦22場科普課堂。活動包括工業AI、電子皮膚、外骨骼機械人等主題，亦有AI創作、智能生活應用同AI反詐分享。
items.imageAlt: 宣傳畫面：2026香港AI科普周暨AI未來生活節

items.title: The Verge: WSJ profile says Dario Amodei once suggested video games could ease AI joblessness
items.summary: The Verge 引述《華爾街日報》在 Anthropic 上市後刊登的 Amodei 兄妹專訪，指 Dario Amodei 早年在 OpenAI 時，曾在流傳的 Slack 訊息中同同事討論，以沉浸式電子遊戲緩解 AI 導致失業所引發的政治衝突。報道將呢段描述為專訪中的逸事，並非 Anthropic 官方政策。
items.note: This is second-hand reporting of a Wall Street Journal profile and purported Slack messages. Anthropic policy status is not confirmed in The Verge article.
items.imageAlt: The Verge artwork for a story on Dario Amodei and AI joblessness

items.title: WIRED: U.S. banks tighten rules on third-party AI agents as Wells Fargo terms take effect
items.summary: WIRED 報道，美國多家銀行正限制第三方 AI agent 登入客戶帳戶，並將 agent 出錯甚至被盜的責任撥向客戶；Wells Fargo 更新條款將於周二生效，寫明使用 AI agent 須自行承擔風險。報道又指，JPMorgan Chase 已禁止用客戶憑證登入的第三方 agent，Bank of America、Citibank 同 PNC 亦已作出相關警示或條款改動。
items.note: WIRED displayed the byline as Nov 22, 2026, 6:00 AM without a time zone. publishedAt assumes Pacific Time, where WIRED is based (10:00 p.m. HKT).
items.imageAlt: Photo accompanying WIRED’s report on banks restricting AI agents

items.title: TechCrunch: Microdrama startup Shortical licenses actor Aki Avni's likeness for an AI series
items.summary: TechCrunch 報道，微短劇公司 Shortical 推出全 AI 製作劇集《Inevitable》，並與以色列演員 Aki Avni 達成其首個面部肖像授權合作，由 AI 生成嘅虛擬形象主演。公司行政總裁 Guy Shimoni 表示，AI 讓較小團隊都能製作電影級規模作品；Avni 則稱呢次嘗試既緊張亦令人興奮。
items.imageAlt: Key art for Shortical's AI microdrama Inevitable

items.title: Taiwan officials flag Nov 23 as key to stabilize markets after a record weekly drop
items.summary: 《工商時報》11月23日盤前報道，台股上周下跌7,641點，創史上最大單周跌點；財經高層指今日是穩住市場信心的關鍵，並指國安基金應加大護盤力道，鎖定台積電等大型權值股。報道又指，證交所22日與十大券商就融資維持率由130%降至120%達成共識，市場預期最快24或25日上路，實施細節仍待金管會公布。
items.note: This is a pre-open briefing; Taiwan's cash market had not yet opened when the item was filed. The article's accompanying image is a 2025 stock photo, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: South Korea starts preparations to activate its stock market stabilization fund
items.summary: 韓聯社報道，副總理兼財政經濟部長李炯逸11月22日主持緊急市場檢查會議，F4 財金首長因應美股下跌以及 AI、半導體前景不確定，決定着手準備，以便視乎情況即時啟動證券市場穩定基金，將是2008年金融海嘯後18年來首次。當局亦計劃由24日起三個月放寬上市公司每日回購自身股票的下單上限，並由金監院同交易所展開三個月非法賣空特別監察。
items.note: Yonhap photos on this page are marked as not for redistribution, so imageUrl is null. publishedAt converts the 21:51 KST dateline to HKT.

items.title: Stellaris: Willpower is listed to launch November 23 on Steam
items.summary: Paradox 策略作《Stellaris》資料片《Willpower》喺 Steam 標示 11 月 23 日推出，將 Ethics 升級成可向其他帝國傳播嘅 Ideologies，並加入可遷移嘅 Galactic Halls 等機制。查稿時商店頁仍顯示約 14 小時後解鎖，尚未上線。
items.note: Steam listed the release date as Nov 23, 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. At research time the store page still said the DLC planned to unlock later the same day, so this is a listed launch rather than a confirmed 'out now'.
items.imageAlt: Stellaris: Willpower Steam capsule art

items.title: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic – Space Program is listed to launch November 23 on Steam
items.summary: Hooded Horse 發行、3Division 開發嘅《Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic》資料片《Space Program》喺 Steam 標示 11 月 23 日推出，加入航天科研、火箭組裝同發射設施，以及 1960 年代相關內容。查稿時商店頁仍顯示約 18 小時後解鎖，並且需要本體先可遊玩。
items.note: Steam listed the release date as Nov 23, 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. At research time the store page still said the DLC planned to unlock later the same day and requires the base game.
items.imageAlt: Workers & Resources: Soviet Republic – Space Program Steam capsule art

items.title: Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler is listed to launch November 23 on PC, consoles and Switch
items.summary: Checkpoint Gaming 指出，Pushka Studios 嘅放鬆工廠解謎作《Jaden Industries: Cozy Automation Puzzler》標示於 11 月 23 日登陸 PC、PS5、Xbox One／Series、Switch 同 Switch 2，玩家要喺浮空島上組裝緊湊生產鏈。查稿時 Steam 仍顯示同日稍後先解鎖，所以係已排期發售，而唔係已經上線。
items.note: Checkpoint Gaming dated the weekly roundup November 22, 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. Steam independently listed the same PC date and, at research time, still showed the game unlocking later on November 23. The Checkpoint page og:image is key art for a different game in the same roundup, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Dead by Daylight: Terrifier is listed to launch November 24 on Steam
items.summary: Checkpoint Daily 引述 Steam，指《Dead by Daylight》新章節《Terrifier》標示 11 月 24 日喺 PC 推出，加入殺人小丑 Art the Clown 同倖存者 Sienna Shaw，並且需要本體先可遊玩。
items.note: Checkpoint Daily timestamps the article November 22, 2026 at 02:44 without a timezone, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. Platforms are limited to PC because that is what the cited Steam listing supports; other storefronts were not confirmed in this source. The article og:image is for another game in the same roundup, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Arkheron is dated November 27 for early access on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: Checkpoint Daily 報道，Bonfire Studios 嘅三人隊伍動作遊戲《Arkheron》將於 11 月 27 日喺 PC、PS5 同 Xbox Series 進入搶先體驗，美國售價 24.99 美元。11 月 27 至 29 日開放週末免費遊玩，並設 Friend Pass；同日亦會加入 Game Pass Ultimate 同 PC Game Pass。
items.note: Checkpoint Daily timestamps the article November 22, 2026 at 02:44 without a timezone, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. The article og:image is for another game in the same roundup, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Reshine is dated November 26 for PC, PS5, Xbox Series and Switch
items.summary: Checkpoint Gaming 指出，解壓清潔遊戲《Reshine》標示 11 月 26 日登陸 PC、PS5、Xbox Series 同 Switch，玩家用工具清理舊物上嘅塵同鏽，冇經營或時間壓力。
items.note: Checkpoint Gaming dated the weekly roundup November 22, 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. The page og:image is key art for a different game in the same roundup, so imageUrl is null.

items.title: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year is out now on Steam
items.summary: Lobstudio 喜劇解謎作《Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year》已喺 Steam 上線，Steam 標示發行日為 11 月 21 日。故仔講喪屍偵探同警員迷拍檔，喺一個困喺盛夏卻像嚴冬嘅村莊，用 Zombie Dive 同 Journal 調查 VTuber 直播裡發生嘅悲劇。
items.note: Steam lists the release date as Nov 21, 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. At research time the store showed user reviews and a 10% discount, confirming it was live. This launch was not in the Nov 21–22 batches.
items.imageAlt: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year Steam capsule art

items.title: CachyOS November 2026 release adds Easy Anti-Cheat Linux v2 support
items.summary: GamingOnLinux 報道，CachyOS 11 月版本已加入 Easy Anti-Cheat Linux v2 支援，提供獨立核心 linux-cachyos-eac 同開機項目，並要求 Secure Boot、TPM 2.0、IOMMU 同 kernel lockdown。一般開機項目會保留，只用嚟玩需要 EAC 嘅遊戲；新脚本 eac-setup 同 eac-status 負責設定同檢查。
items.note: GamingOnLinux timestamped the article 22 Nov 2026 at 12:55 pm UTC, converted to HKT.
items.imageAlt: CachyOS logo from the GamingOnLinux report

items.title: Entergram teases a Farland Saga 30th anniversary project
items.summary: Gematsu 報道，Entergram 喺社交平台宣傳 Farland Saga 30 周年企劃，寫住「1996 to 2026. After 30 years, a new story is set in motion」，但未公布作品名稱、平台、發行日或玩法詳情。
items.note: Gematsu timestamped the article Nov 21, 2026, 10:55 PM EST, converted to HKT. Entergram did not announce a title, platforms, or release date, so those fields are omitted.
items.imageAlt: Farland Saga 30th anniversary teaser image from Gematsu

items.title: Nicalis removes AI-generated music from The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+
items.summary: GamesRadar+ 報道，玩家喺《The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+》新加嘅 GTA 主題 run 發現 Suno 生成嘅音樂後，製作人 Edmund McMillen 話自己事先唔知情，正在追查來源。Nicalis 已喺 PC 推出更新移除相關檔案，並已提交俾 Microsoft、Nintendo 同 Sony；遊戲近期 Steam 評價跌至 Overwhelmingly Negative。
items.note: GamesRadar+ dated the article 22 November 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. The PC patch is described as already live; the console update was reported as submitted, with no console release date given.
items.imageAlt: The Binding of Isaac artwork used in the GamesRadar+ report

items.title: Unreal Engine 6 will not include Blueprints, even in early access, Epic says
items.summary: PC Gamer 報道，Epic 開發執行副總裁 Marcus Wassmer 喺官方網誌寫明，Unreal Engine 6 包括 Early Access 都唔會再有 Blueprints 同 Actor Gameplay Framework，遊戲玩法會改用 Verse 同新嘅 Scene Graph。公司原先計劃喺 UE6 初期兩者並存，但而家認為 AI 可以大幅協助甚至自動完成 UE5 專案轉換，因而提前棄用。
items.note: PC Gamer dated the article 22 November 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. The article says Epic's post itself appeared Friday, November 19; this item reflects the Nov 22 report, which was not in earlier batches.
items.imageAlt: Unreal Engine imagery from the PC Gamer report

items.title: Dota 2 patch 7.42 adds the Greater Horn of Battle in a bid to shorten matches
items.summary: PC Gamer 報道，Dota 2 更新 7.42 已推出，其中由 Tormentor 必定掉落嘅 Greater Horn of Battle 可以一次過喺所有行軍線召喚強大小兵，希望加快對局。另外英雄基礎生命由 120 提升至 200，但力量提供嘅生命較少；Glyph of Fortification 喺部分建築被摧毀後唔會再重置冷卻，英雄死亡期間亦會被動獲得經驗。
items.note: PC Gamer dated the article 22 November 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Dota 2 artwork from the PC Gamer patch 7.42 report

items.title: Nvidia's 621.35 hotfix does not fully stop excessive SSD writes, PC Gamer reports
items.summary: PC Gamer 跟進早前 GeForce 熱修驅動 621.35：雖然峰值寫入有下降，而且重啟後短時間似乎改善，但用戶反映問題之後會再出現，有人 overnight 仍錄得每小時約 4.5 GB 日誌覆寫。報道認為暫時較穩妥仍然係回退到 621.01，並等確認安全先更新。
items.note: This is an update to the Nov 21 batch item on the 621.35 hotfix release. PC Gamer dated the article 22 November 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. The 4.5 GB per hour figure is attributed to a user report cited by PC Gamer.
items.imageAlt: Nvidia graphics hardware imagery from the PC Gamer report

items.title: AION 2 will open a cross-server World Market and World Exchange on November 25
items.summary: TalkEsport 引述 NC 公告，指《AION 2》將於 11 月 25 日更新加入跨伺服器 World Market 同 World Exchange，只限同一陣營同地區嘅玩家交易。兩項功能只開放俾 Membership 用戶，買賣有 20% 稅，每日各限 10 個上架；原本嘅 Server Market 同 Server Exchange 仍然保留。
items.note: TalkEsport timestamped the article 21 Nov 2026, 8:11 PM IST, converted to HKT. The official NC notice page did not return readable content at research time, so this item follows TalkEsport's account of that notice.
items.imageAlt: AION 2 artwork from the TalkEsport report

items.title: Gothic 3 Classic is listed to launch November 24 on PS5 and Xbox Series
items.summary: Checkpoint Daily 報道，《Gothic 3 Classic》將於 11 月 24 日登陸 PS5 同 Xbox Series X|S，以 2006 年 PC 版為基礎，並帶有 Community Patch 1.75、後續改進同手掣介面。原本同日推出嘅 Switch 2 版已改為 2027 年初。
items.note: Checkpoint Daily timestamps the article November 22, 2026 at 02:44 without a timezone, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. The Switch 2 delay to early 2027 is included as context from this weekly report; no exact Switch 2 date was given, so releaseDate refers to the PS5 and Xbox Series launch.
items.imageAlt: Gothic 3 Classic artwork from the Checkpoint Daily weekly releases report

items.title: GTA 6's album is reported to have set a Spotify soundtrack opening-day record
items.summary: Push Square 報道，《GTA VI: The Album》開售首日喺 Spotify 錄得 2985 萬次串流，稱呢個係平台史上最高嘅原聲帶開賣日紀錄。專輯有 34 首歌，包括 Dua Lipa、Travis Scott、Morgan Wallen 同 JENNIE 等人嘅新曲。
items.note: Push Square displayed a relative timestamp without an exact clock time, so publishedAt uses the article date at T00:00:00+08:00. The 29.85 million figure is reported by Push Square via a Pop Base post; a Spotify official page was not independently checked, so uncertain is true.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto 6 artwork from the Push Square soundtrack report

items.title: Rockstar says GTA 6 simulates a full gang drug-supply network behind the scenes
items.summary: PC Gamer 引述 Rockstar 開放世界高級設計總監 Steven Messinger 接受 IGN 訪問時表示，《GTA 6》幫派據點有一套完整規劃嘅毒品網絡，包括來源、運入方式、各據點分發，以至點樣落到街頭買家。佢話玩家通常只會見到零碎細節，但呢套背景結構令世界即使喺玩家唔喺場時都更似持續運作。
items.note: PC Gamer dated the article 22 November 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Grand Theft Auto 6 scene from the PC Gamer report on its drug-supply simulation

items.title: Rockstar says GTA 6's Jason was inspired by Steve McQueen and Army veteran research
items.summary: PC Gamer 引述 Rockstar 敘事高級副總裁 Rupert Humphries 向 Destructoid 表示，雙主角之一 Jason Duval 少說話嘅性格，參考了 Steve McQueen 喺 Peckinpah 電影《The Getaway》用氣場多過對白嘅演出，亦同工作室對陸軍 Ranger 等退伍軍人嘅研究有共鳴。遊戲裡 Jason 屬於 Marauders 呢個虛構軍隊體系，Humphries 形容呢類人通常唔會冇必要咁多說話。
items.note: PC Gamer dated the article 22 November 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00.
items.imageAlt: Jason Duval in Grand Theft Auto 6, from the PC Gamer report

items.title: E.T. designer Howard Scott Warshaw likens the AI game glut to the lead-up to the 1983 crash
items.summary: PC Gamer 報道，Atari《E.T.》設計師 Howard Scott Warshaw 喺 DevGAMM Lisbon 演講中，將生成式 AI 令大量低質遊戲湧入 Steam 等平台，比喻成 1983 年美國遊戲業崩潰前「市場充斥垃圾」嘅情況。佢同時認為 AI 亦會幫有想法嘅開發者實現作品，對行業可以係「非常正面」嘅轉變，重點會由技術轉向遊戲設計。
items.note: PC Gamer dated the article 22 November 2026 with no clock time, so publishedAt uses T00:00:00+08:00. The article says the talk took place the previous week and cites GamesIndustry.biz; this item reflects the Nov 22 PC Gamer report.
items.imageAlt: Portrait imagery of Atari designer Howard Scott Warshaw from the PC Gamer report

items.title: Wizards of the Coast will pass its Anthropic settlement share to D&D writers
items.summary: Polygon 報道，Dungeons & Dragons 發行商 Wizards of the Coast 喺 Anthropic 15 億美元版權和解中，決定放棄出版商通常分走嘅一半份額，將呢筆款項交俾相關作者。Wizards 致作者信寫明，雖然公司係註冊版權持有人，但優先承認創作呢啲世界嘅作者；作家 James Lowder 形容金額以數十萬美元計。
items.note: Polygon timestamped the article Nov 21, 2026, 10:59 AM EST, converted to HKT. Platforms are omitted because this concerns tabletop/book authors rather than a specific game platform. The page hero image filename appears to mix D&D with unrelated art, so imageUrl is null.
